pinterest.title: Best Time to Get Married in Greece by Month
pinterest.description: Planning a Greek island wedding? Our month by month guide, April to October, uses long-term station averages. June to August is the hot, dry core at Naxos, Heraklion, Chania Souda and Rodos, with Kerkyra (Corfu) the wetter exception. In July, Naxos averages a 27.1°C maximum and 0.4 rain days. In October, Kerkyra averages 11.4 rain days. Match the month to your island, your guests and your ceremony.

pinterest.title: Greece Wedding Weather by Month: Heat, Rain Days and Wind by Island
pinterest.description: How hot is a Greek island wedding in summer? In August, Kerkyra averages a 31.5°C maximum and Rodos 30.7°C, while Naxos averages 27.0°C. Smartraveller says summer heatwaves are frequent in Greece and wildfires occur from June to September, so plan shade, water and an evening ceremony. In the Cyclades, the Naxos station records a north wind in every month, stronger from July to October.

pinterest.title: Greek Orthodox Wedding Dates: Closed Periods to Plan Around
pinterest.description: Planning a Greek Orthodox church wedding? Check the calendar before the weather. The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Australia lists dates when marriages are not permitted, including Great Lent to Easter Sunday, 1 to 15 August, 29 August and 14 September. Orthodox Easter moves each year, so confirm your dates with your priest and, for a wedding in Greece, the local Metropolis.

instagram_carousel.caption:
No single month suits every Greek wedding. It comes down to four things: the island, how your guests cope with heat, whether you want a church ceremony, and how long everyone will stay.

Here is what long-term Hellenic National Meteorological Service station averages show, April to October.

June to August is the hot, dry core at Naxos, Heraklion, Chania Souda and Rodos. In July, rain days average 0.4 at Naxos and 0.2 at Rodos. Kerkyra (Corfu) is the wetter exception, with three or more rain days in every month from May to October.

The heat is real. In August, Kerkyra averages a 31.5°C maximum and Rodos 30.7°C, while Naxos averages 27.0°C. Smartraveller says summer heatwaves are frequent in Greece and wildfires occur from June to September, so high-summer weddings need shade, water and evening timing.

May and October are milder. October maximums average 21.9°C at Naxos and 24.5°C at Rodos, with rain days rising to 5.5 and 6.5, and to 11.4 at Kerkyra. Choose a venue with a covered space.

Planning a Greek Orthodox church wedding? The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Australia lists dates when marriages are not permitted, including Great Lent to Easter Sunday, 1 to 15 August, 29 August and 14 September. Confirm with your priest.

Once you have two or three months in mind, your Wedded Advisor turns them into dates a venue can hold, as your single point of contact, working in your time zone and quoting in AUD. Tap the link in our bio to read the full month by month guide.

Which month are you leaning towards? Tell us in the comments.
